title: Sprint 12 Kickoff
raw_text:
Sarah: Welcome everyone. Sprint 12 starts today. Our main goal this sprint is to finish the database migration from MySQL to PostgreSQL. Karim, you own this. Deadline is March 14.

Karim: Understood. I will start with the schema conversion this week. I need Youssef to freeze the frontend API calls by Wednesday so I can map all the endpoints.

Youssef: I can do that. I will have the API call inventory ready by Wednesday March 5.

Lina: On the product side, we are pushing the new dashboard feature to Sprint 13. This sprint is only about the migration. No new features.

Sarah: Agreed. Migration is the only priority. Karim, please write a rollback plan by March 7 in case something breaks.

Karim: Will do. I will document the rollback steps and share them on Confluence by Friday March 7.

Sarah: Good. Let us meet again on March 10 for a mid-sprint check. Meeting adjourned.
